hints.title: Monotonic Trip Capacity
hints.text: If all buses can complete totalTrips in time T, they can also complete at least totalTrips in any time greater than T.

hints.title: Compute Total Trips for Given Time
hints.text: In duration T, bus i completes floor(T / time[i]) trips. Sum these values across all buses.

hints.title: Binary Search Search Space
hints.text: Binary search T within the range [1, min(time) * totalTrips] to locate the earliest qualifying time.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N log(min(time) * totalTrips)) binary search on answer
complexity.notes: Binary search on monotonic time threshold.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating minute by minute requires up to 10^14 iterations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search tests each time candidate in O(N) over at most 50 steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify monotonic capacity function and define tight upper bound.

solutions.approach: Python binary search on trip time.
